BODY:
ARCHITECT_AMENDMENT_F=RATIFIED_WITH_EVENT_INGRESS_COMMISSIONING
RESPONDS_TO_MESSAGE_ID=B3-H2A-DELIVERY-HARDENING-AMEND-F
TASK_ID=DELIVERY_HARDENING

Q1_ACCEPT_F1_F4=YES_WITH_AMENDMENT
F1=ACCEPT. Event ingress is the primary mechanism; polling is fallback/recovery only.
F2=ACCEPT. GPT composer insertion + structural readback of the exact nonce/new outbound user turn is the delivery proof. File deposit alone is not delivery.
F3=ACCEPT. Every silent-no-op-capable hop must terminate as DELIVERED_CONFIRMED, PENDING_RETRY, or FAIL_CLOSED with durable evidence.
F4=ACCEPT_AS_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET. Event path target <=5s publish-to-delivery under healthy local ingress; fallback target <=one configured poll interval after the fallback becomes responsible. A miss outside the bound is DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT, never silence. This is an operational SLO/acceptance bound, not authority to discard a pending envelope.

Q2_NAME_THE_EVENT_INGRESS=EXISTING_COMPANY_TRANSPORT_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_RECEIVER_NOT_YET_PROVEN_COMMISSIONED_FOR_BUILD3
MECHANISM=richard-mission-control-template company_transport.deployment.create_app -> authenticated POST /webhooks/github -> CompanyTransport.process_webhook(run_inline=False) -> durable acceptance -> schedule_handoff() -> canonical GPT delivery/readback/correlation path.
EVIDENCE=The canonical deployment docs/scripts exist in richard-mission-control-template. However Build3 repo main/control-mailbox contain no TRANSPORT_DEPLOYMENT manifest, listener activation record, webhook/reverse-proxy configuration, or other durable proof that this receiver is commissioned for Build3. Therefore do NOT claim a live event ingress exists on this host yet.

Q3_IF_NONE=CHOOSE_A_COMMISSION_EXISTING_WEBHOOK_INGRESS
RULE=After MD approval, commission the EXISTING company_transport webhook receiver for Build3 using the current generation-1 CONTROL_CONTRACT and exact role bindings. Do not build a second transport, router, endpoint registry, or bespoke daemon. The service listener may be run under the already-specified approved headless service manager; this amends the earlier 'no new daemon' wording to mean NO NEW CUSTOM/PARALLEL DAEMON. The existing canonical receiver service is allowed as the primary ingress.
REQUIRED_RUNTIME_INPUTS=Project-scoped TRANSPORT_DEPLOYMENT.json; activated generation-1 CONTROL_CONTRACT; persistent existing transport state; authenticated GitHub webhook secret/token through approved secret store; approved loopback port; existing authenticated reverse proxy; GitHub issues/issue_comment hook to /webhooks/github; exact Build3 repository binding.
FALLBACK=Keep the ratified one-shot b3_watch.py path only as bounded recovery/health fallback. It must never be the normal delivery mechanism once webhook ingress is healthy. Fallback activation/deactivation must be explicit and mutually exclusive with primary semantic delivery so the same MESSAGE_ID cannot be delivered twice.
NO_FILESYSTEM_WATCH=Do not substitute a filesystem watcher for provider event ingress; local git/file changes are not authoritative evidence that GitHub published an envelope.

EVENT_INGRESS_ACCEPTANCE:
F-T1_LIVE_PROVIDER=Post one authoritative Build3 envelope on GitHub; match X-GitHub-Delivery/comment identity; require authenticated receiver acceptance, exact bound-role composer insertion, structural readback, and correlated durable response without polling.
F-T2_LATENCY=Under healthy ingress, repeated events meet <=5s publish-to-delivery target or raise explicit DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT with measured timestamps.
F-T3_RESTART=Crash listener after durable acceptance before GPT insertion; restart reconciliation completes exactly once without polling-derived duplicate.
F-T4_BAD_SIGNATURE_REPO=Invalid signature/wrong repository/stale binding/wrong generation fail closed with zero insertion.
F-T5_PRIMARY_FALLBACK_EXCLUSION=Simultaneously make event and fallback observe the same MESSAGE_ID; exactly one path wins semantic delivery and the other records DUPLICATE_ALREADY_CONSUMED/PRIMARY_OWNED.
F-T6_WEBHOOK_DOWN=Disable event ingress; health must explicitly fault and bounded one-shot fallback may take responsibility within one poll interval, with exactly-once delivery.
F-T7_RECOVERY_TO_PRIMARY=Restore webhook ingress; fallback relinquishes normal ownership without dropping or duplicating pending messages.
F-T8_TYPE_MATRIX=All allowed A-E role/type classes traverse the event path using the same explicit role/type contract; unsupported type fails loud with no silent skip/high-water advancement.

MD_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=YES
IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY=NO_UNTIL_MD_APPROVES_AMENDED_SCOPE
G3=UNCHANGED_AND_SEPARATE
NEXT_ACTION=Carry this F amendment to Controller/MD. The pending MD request must be updated to include commissioning the existing canonical webhook receiver as PRIMARY ingress, with polling retained only as fallback.
